title: Album release: VH1 Storytellers by Ringo Starr | 1998
content:
VH1 Storytellers, the fourth live album by Ringo Starr, was released on 20 October 1998.

It was recorded by Starr and his band, dubbed The Roundheads, for the VH1 Storytellers TV show at Sony Studios in New York City on 13 May 1998.

The recording came one month prior to the release of Starr’s Vertical Man album, and featured stories and anecdotes in between performances.

VH1 Storytellers was Starr’s first live album without the All-Starr Band. The audio was mixed at Westlake Studios and Blue House Studios in Los Angeles by Scott Gordon and Mark Hudson.
